name: album-deduplicator-frontend
description: Windows desktop shell for Album Deduplicator
author: NHLOCAL

scripts.dev:electron: npm run sync:icons && concurrently -k "vite --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --dir --publish never
scripts.dist:desktop: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never
scripts.dist:desktop:publish: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish always
